## AGR: Master agreement (`agreement`)

ISDA, GMRA or GMSLA master agreement with its key elections.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Contract | [agreement.contract.yaml](../../../config/packs/counterparty-risk/contracts/agreement.contract.yaml) · version 1.0 |
| Class | fundamental |
| Status | active |
| Source | legal-docs |
| Grain | One row per master agreement per business date, keyed by AGREEMENT_ID. |
| Key | `AGREEMENT_ID` |
| Id pattern | `^AGR-` |
| Dated by | `business_date` |
| Cadence | daily (due: to be confirmed) |
| Storage | connector `legal-store` (plugin `delta`), table `<root>/legal/agreement/` |
| Test data | data/testdata/counterparty-risk/agreement |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AGREEMENT_ID` | id | required |  | The record's id (the business key) | `AGR-ALDERSHOT-ISDA` (pattern `^AGR-`) |  |
| `TYPE` | text | required |  | The master agreement form, for example the ISDA 2002 Master Agreement. | `ISDA 2002 Master` |  |
| `COUNTERPARTY_NAME` | text | required |  | The legal entity that signed the agreement with the bank. | `Aldershot Pension Trust` |  |
| `GOVERNING_LAW` | text | required |  | The law the agreement is read under, which decides how close-out netting is enforced. | `English`, `New York` |  |
| `SIGNED` | date | required |  | The date the agreement was signed. | `2015-12-10` |  |
| `CLOSE_OUT_NETTING` | text | required |  | Whether a legal opinion confirms that on default the trades net to one amount; only then may exposure be netted. | `Enforceable` |  |
| `ELECTIONS` | record | required |  | Elections: the election it refers to |  | `election` |
| `COUNTERPARTY` | id | required |  | Counterparty: the counterparty it refers to | `CP-ALDERSHOT` (pattern `^CP-`) | `counterparty` |
| `CSA` | id | required |  | CSA: the csa it refers to | `CSA-ALDERSHOT` (pattern `^CSA-`) | `csa` |

**Nested `ELECTIONS`**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AUTOMATIC_EARLY_TERMINATION` | boolean | required |  | Whether the trades end by themselves on certain defaults, without a notice. | `False` |  |
| `CROSS_DEFAULT` | text | required |  | The threshold above which a default on other debt is a default under this agreement. | `3% of shareholders' equity` |  |
| `SET_OFF` | boolean | required |  | Whether amounts owed under other contracts may be set off against the close-out amount. | `True` |  |
| `TERMINATION_CURRENCY` | text | required |  | The currency the close-out amount is paid in. | `USD` |  |
| `ADDITIONAL_TERMINATION_EVENTS` | text | required |  | Further events, such as a downgrade, that let a party end the trades. | `Rating downgrade below BBB-` |  |
| `PROTOCOLS` | text | required |  | The ISDA protocols both parties adhered to, which amend the agreement. | `ISDA 2020 IBOR Fallbacks; 2018 US Resolution Stay` |  |

**Links:** `ELECTIONS` → `election`, `COUNTERPARTY` → `counterparty`, `CSA` → `csa`.

**Validation**

- required: fields `AGREEMENT_ID`, `TYPE`, `COUNTERPARTY_NAME`, `GOVERNING_LAW`, `SIGNED`, `CLOSE_OUT_NETTING`, `ELECTIONS`, `COUNTERPARTY`, `CSA`
- unique: key `AGREEMENT_ID`; per business_date
- pattern: field AGREEMENT_ID; pattern ^AGR-
- enum: field GOVERNING_LAW; values `English`, `New York`
- link: field ELECTIONS; kind election
- link: field COUNTERPARTY; kind counterparty
- link: field CSA; kind csa

- Dated by the lake's business_date partition: `drishti.py lake build` writes each test-data file's day into it; the documents carry no date field of their own.

## SIMM: ISDA SIMM initial margin (`simm`)

Initial margin by risk class and product class.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Contract | [simm.contract.yaml](../../../config/packs/counterparty-risk/contracts/simm.contract.yaml) · version 1.0 |
| Class | computed |
| Status | retiring in 2.9.0, replaced by docs/contracts/SIMM.md |
| Source | margin-engine |
| Grain | One row per isda simm initial margin per business date, keyed by CALC_ID. |
| Key | `CALC_ID` |
| Id pattern | `^SIMM-` |
| Dated by | `business_date` |
| Cadence | daily (due: to be confirmed) |
| Storage | connector `collateral-store` (plugin `delta`), table `<root>/collateral/simm/` |
| Test data | data/testdata/counterparty-risk/simm |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CALC_ID` | id | required |  | The record's id (the business key) | `SIMM-ALDERSHOT` (pattern `^SIMM-`) |  |
| `TOTAL` | amount | derived | USD | The margin the ISDA SIMM model requires, built from the sensitivities of the trades by risk class and product class. *computed by ISDA SIMM; removed when retired* | `7068571` |  |
| `POSTED` | amount | derived | USD | The initial margin the bank has delivered to the counterparty or a custodian. *computed by ISDA SIMM; removed when retired* | `6856514` |  |
| `RECEIVED` | amount | derived | USD | The initial margin the counterparty has delivered to the bank. *computed by ISDA SIMM; removed when retired* | `7209942` |  |
| `VERSION` | text | required |  | The version of the ISDA Standard Initial Margin Model the calculation used; the model is recalibrated each year. | `ISDA SIMM 2.7` |  |
| `RISK_CLASSES` | record list | derived |  | Nested: see nested RISK_CLASSES[] *computed by ISDA SIMM; removed when retired* |  |  |
| `NETTING_SET` | id | required |  | Netting set: the netting-set it refers to | `NS-ALDERSHOT-FRA` (pattern `^NS-`) | `netting-set` |
| `COUNTERPARTY` | id | required |  | Counterparty: the counterparty it refers to | `CP-ALDERSHOT` (pattern `^CP-`) | `counterparty` |

| `IM` | amount | required | USD | The initial margin of one SIMM risk class: interest rate, credit qualifying, credit non-qualifying, equity, commodity or FX. | `3180857` |  |

**Links:** `NETTING_SET` → `netting-set`, `COUNTERPARTY` → `counterparty`.
